description: PAID ($0.002): discover a site's URLs from its sitemap and robots.txt plus a 1-hop same-host crawl, and return them as a JSON list. Cheaper than crawling each page with webcap_extract.

maxUrls.description: Maximum number of URLs to return. Integer 1-50; default 20 when omitted.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to process, e.g. https://example.com/

name: webcap_map_lite
